About Atypical Games

Founded in 2005 by a group of passionate video game developers, Atypical Games is the only 100% Romanian game development studio to have received an Apple Design Award.

We are the creators of Cubic Odyssey™, Sky Gamblers™, Radiation Island™, and the Battle Supremacy™ series, developing premium games enjoyed by millions of players worldwide.

We're looking for a talented C++ Game Programmer to join our team and help build the next generation of our games.

What You'll Do

  • Design and implement game mechanics and gameplay systems using reliable, maintainable, and efficient C++ code.
  • Develop and optimize existing game systems and engine features.
  • Create tools that improve the game development pipeline.
  • Collaborate closely with designers, artists, and other programmers to implement new features.
  • Debug, profile, and fix issues while maintaining high performance.
  • Work across multiple platforms, including PC, PlayStation, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch.
  • Contribute to code reviews and continuously improve code quality.

Your Profile

  • Degree in Computer Science or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Strong C++ programming skills with solid knowledge of object-oriented programming (OOP).
  • Understanding of one or more game engine systems such as rendering, animation, AI, networking, physics, or audio.
  • Passion for creating high-quality video games.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and able to work with minimal supervision.
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills.
  • Team player who enjoys collaborating in a multidisciplinary environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience developing games for consoles (PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch).
  • Experience developing multiplayer or online games.
  • Experience with cloud technologies and backend services (AWS or similar).
  • Knowledge of client-server architectures and online networking.
  • Experience optimizing game performance across multiple platforms.
  • Familiarity with version control systems (Git, Perforce).

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Meal tickets.
  • Private medical insurance.
  • Friendly and experienced development team.
  • Opportunity to work on original games played by millions of users worldwide.
  • Career growth and professional development.
  • The chance to work with proprietary technology and contribute to every stage of game development.
